notes:
Another player is no longer mistaken for you: started mid-session, the meter could pin your name on a nearby player of a different class the moment the game sent him a burst of permanent buffs, and show you soloing a boss you were 100 m away from. A body wearing another name or class is refused now.

An Elementalist's spirit no longer appears as a sixth party member when the party has two Elementalists; a spirit without a settled owner stays out of the list, and the game's own spirit-to-master link is followed even for your own character.

Lower Reshanta timers: a boss the server had no time for was shown with the next boss's time (Argo with Executor Tamasa's), and Watcher Kaira read an hour short - her cycle starts at 01:00 server time.

The Odyle counter in the header was black on black. The debug log no longer floods itself with one line per stale target per poll.

New: a Favourites tab in the world boss table - the bosses you have an alert on, from every region at once - and countdowns to the second in the table and the footer.
